component_scope: Only the exact libc-gconv-modules-extra2.43-7 tuples; this is not an exclusion for libc6.
mapping_reason: The245 exact extra gconv ELF files are character conversion modules and contain none of the affected implementations/imports or the reviewed libc wrapper entries. The actual regex and wide-scanner implementations reside in the separately packaged libc.so.6. Propagating a source-package CVE to these binary-component tuples does not show those modules contain that implementation.
limitations: Character converters may be called by the affected libc scanner. That does not make the converter the implementation of the scanner defect, and does not exclude the real libc6 finding. Actual libc6 needs its own current-path review.
